title: Massachusetts dispensing of out-of-state Schedule II prescriptions
rule_summary: Massachusetts applies a five-day presentation window and different issuing-state conditions to out-of-state narcotic and nonnarcotic Schedule II prescriptions.
exam_relevance: A valid analysis must classify the drug as narcotic or nonnarcotic, identify the issuing state, and apply the Massachusetts timing gate before ordinary validity checks.

numeric_facts.conditions: Out-of-state Schedule II prescription presented in Massachusetts

common_confusions: Passing the state and timing gates does not prove authenticity or compel dispensing.
The specified-state restriction for narcotic Schedule II prescriptions must not be imposed on the nonnarcotic pathway.
verification_notes: Statute and current Massachusetts official circular letter checked on 2026-08-13.
